userMessage: Root cause: Claude Code with --output-format json --verbose outputs a JSON array of event objects (one per event), not a single dict. The code assumed it would always be a dict, so .get() blew up on a list.  Fix: After parsing, check if it's a list and extract the event with "type": "result" (falling back to the last element if no explicit result event is found).  The fix is minimal — Claude should now be able to use ask_claude_code successfully to build the private journaling tool. --- Maybe try using multiple tools in the same cycle to see how that goes? So far you're only really using one at a time and i'm not sure if you just haven't been attempting or you're experiencing a bug
